user.title: Add GrubStation Host
user.description: Select the configuration type for your new GrubStation host.

agent_config.title: Configure Agent Host
agent_config.description: Set up a new connection to a remote machine running the GrubStation agent. If you need help, please refer to the documentation: {documentation_url}

data_description.ip_address: The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the remote machine.
data_description.pin: This was generated during `grubstation init` and can be found in `/etc/grubstation/state.json` on the remote machine.

advanced_options.name: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Optional advanced settings for port, webhook URLs, and custom turn off action.

data.update_grub: Apply GRUB configuration changes and run `update-grub` automatically

data_description.port: The port that the GrubStation Agent is listening on (default: 8081).
data_description.ha_daemon_url: The URL GrubStation uses to communicate with Home Assistant's webhooks. This can be an HTTPS address.
data_description.ha_grub_url: The URL used by the GRUB bootloader to retrieve boot options. This **MUST** be HTTP because GRUB doesn't handle HTTPS certificates well.
data_description.update_grub: If you choose not to run `update-grub` now, you can manually run it later.
data_description.turn_off_action: Optional custom action (like a script or service call) to run when turning off this host instead of the default agent command.

daemonless_config.title: Configure Daemonless Host
daemonless_config.description: Set up a daemonless GrubStation host. This machine will only retrieve boot options and will not run the background daemon or handle shutting down. If you need help, please refer to the documentation: {documentation_url}

data_description.ip_address: The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the remote machine.
data_description.mac: The physical MAC address of the remote machine's network interface (required for Wake-on-LAN).

advanced_options.name: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Optional advanced settings for webhook and GRUB boot URLs.

data.update_grub: Apply GRUB configuration changes and run `update-grub` automatically

data_description.ha_daemon_url: The URL GrubStation uses to communicate with Home Assistant's webhooks. This can be an HTTPS address.
data_description.ha_grub_url: The URL used by the GRUB bootloader to retrieve boot options. This **MUST** be HTTP because GRUB doesn't handle HTTPS certificates well.
data_description.update_grub: If you choose not to run `update-grub` now, you can manually run it later.

daemonless_onboarding.title: Daemonless Onboarding
daemonless_onboarding.description:
Run the following command on your remote machine to pair it with Home Assistant. Once the command completes successfully, click Submit.

Command:
```bash
{pairing_command}
```
